scope: synthetic single-CIF BaTiO3 P4mm COD 9014273 interpolation only

fresh_data.split_unit: parent q draw before nuisance and noise draws

models.architecture: MeasurementAwareRegressor for A, B, and D; same 1D ResNet-GN backbone and 3-nuisance output head
models.A: direct normalized q MSE only; nuisance outputs receive no direct nuisance or reconstruction loss
models.B: direct normalized q MSE + lambda * measurement-aware expected-profile MSE using predicted eta
models.D: same as B + gamma * MSE(predicted zero shift / 0.06 deg, simulator zero shift / 0.06 deg); gamma=1.0; direct reconstruction-to-q gradient retained
models.D_information_note: D receives simulator zero-shift labels during training and is an extra-information diagnostic, not an equal-information comparison
models.inference_note: No nuisance oracle labels are used at inference

selection.best_epoch_rule: minimum validation mean absolute error across du,dv
selection.lambda_rule: for each method and condition independently, choose lambda with minimum mean best-epoch validation q-MAE across all three paired model seeds; ties choose smaller lambda
selection.test_rule: evaluate selected A/B/D checkpoints once after every method/condition/lambda/seed candidate completes and all validation selection is frozen
selection.profile_fit_rule: on the full test split, compare all methods with the same q-fixed eta-only L-BFGS-B fit, neutral eta start [0,0.105,0.005], same bounds, same objective and max 60 iterations

training.partial_budget_rule: mark PARTIAL and do not read test if the full frozen candidate set does not finish within budget

primary_decision_criteria.V9_support: D mean held-out normalized q-MAE is at least 5% lower than B; D improves q-MAE in at least 2 of 3 paired model seeds; mean a-MAE and c-MAE are each no more than 5% worse than B
primary_decision_criteria.mechanism_check: D held-out zero-shift RMSE is at least 20% lower than B
primary_decision_criteria.simple_guardrail: D mean q-MAE, a-MAE, and c-MAE are each no more than 5% worse than B
primary_decision_criteria.refutation: If shift RMSE improves but V9 q-MAE does not meet the primary criterion, or q improves only with >5% a/c harm, the proposed nuisance-to-q explanation is not supported
primary_decision_criteria.uncertainty: report each seed and mean plus sample SD; three paired seeds are exploratory, not a significance test

secondary_metrics: a and c MAE in angstrom
stop_criteria: source, forward model, or split/hash mismatch
claim_limit: one public CIF, simulator-generated interpolation data; no real PXRD, unseen structures, chemistry generalization, or Rietveld claim
